Aegra PostgreSQL.POSTGRES_DB: Database used for Agent Protocol state, runs, leases, and checkpoints.
Aegra PostgreSQL.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated password for the private pgvector database.

Aegra Redis.REDIS_PASSWORD: Generated password for the private persistent Redis broker.

Aegra.AEGRA_CONFIG: Absolute path to the graph and authentication configuration.
Aegra.AEGRA_API_KEY: Generated bearer token required by every protected Agent Protocol route.
Aegra.AUTH_TYPE: Loads the bundled constant-time bearer-token authenticator.
Aegra.CRON_ENABLED: Runs Aegra's persisted cron scheduler in this instance.
Aegra.DB_ECHO_LOG: Keeps SQL statement logging disabled in production.
Aegra.HOST: Binds the HTTP server to every container interface.
Aegra.METRICS_ENABLED: Keeps the metrics route disabled unless explicitly enabled.
Aegra.OTEL_TARGETS: Optional comma-separated observability targets; empty by default.
Aegra.PORT: HTTP port used by Railway routing and health checks.
Aegra.POSTGRES_DB: Reference to the Aegra database name.
Aegra.REDIS_BROKER_ENABLED: Uses Redis for queued workers and event streaming.
Aegra.REDIS_JOBS_PER_WORKER: Maximum concurrent jobs handled by each worker loop.
Aegra.REDIS_WORKER_COUNT: Worker loops started inside the Aegra instance.
